purpose: After fixed-observation bound and initialization diagnosis, separate node-relative variation from P/Q innovation dependence without changing the physical graph or amplifying load.
gates: Complete fixed N0 candidate LP bound audit.
Resolve the reported parameter domain and freeze one initialization policy using stage2 evidence.
Do not start input controls to hide an unresolved initialization or bound issue.

historical_source.original_use: synthetic algorithm validation with exact linear R/X response; not empirical AC demand

network.true_parameters_use: response generation and post-run scoring only

input_law.local_standardization: same historical per-column mean removal and standard deviation normalization
input_law.deterministic_curves: historical common and terminal-phase functions, unchanged across conditions
input_law.marginal_boundary: same univariate generating law and local component amplitude; finite realized total variances are reported, not falsely asserted identical or rescaled after observing outcomes

conditions.name: common_local_coupled_pq
conditions.p_innovations: broadcast first column of the locked P innovation array to every node
conditions.q_innovations: same common innovations as P, filtered with rho_Q
conditions.interpretation: relative variation still exists in deterministic terminal phases; stochastic local mode is common

conditions.name: node_local_coupled_pq
conditions.q_innovations: same per-node innovations as P, filtered with rho_Q
conditions.interpretation: C0 vs C1 changes stochastic spatial dependence; P/Q are driven by common innovations, not asserted exactly proportional

conditions.name: node_local_independent_pq
conditions.q_innovations: separate locked independent Q innovation array
conditions.interpretation: C1 vs C2 changes P/Q innovation dependence; C2 reproduces the historical generator law

random_streams.per_split_scenario: instantiate original seed RNG; draw complete P innovations then Q innovations once; retain both for all conditions; no outcome-dependent redraw

first_response_domain.model: exact linear Y=P R_true.T + Q X_true.T
first_response_domain.noise: none in first mechanism control; all3 conditions use the same rule
first_response_domain.objective: same raw average absolute error, no intercept, no centering
first_response_domain.claim_scope: algorithm mechanism only; no AC/field or demand-response effectiveness claim

initialization.policy: leaf_plus_rnj frozen after fixed-N0 prefix audit; original15 leaf supports plus original2 N0 algorithm-selected RNJ blocks, identical across all3 conditions
initialization.if_RNJ_prior_used: only original frozen N0 algorithm-selected boundary supports; no truth-derived blocks
initialization.rnj_can_be_scored_separately: recomputed RNJ, if used for a separate comparator, must not silently alter the fixed-family WZZT mechanism comparison
initialization.selection_reason: RNJ-only prefix did not improve root-first ordering; preserve historical mainline as mechanism comparator, not a claim of globally superior initialization
initialization.pipeline_scope: fixed historical RNJ prior followed by production WZZT; do not claim RNJ was rerun on control observations

solver.parameter_domain: Same predeclared nonnegative finite box [0,2] for all3 controls; results describe configured bounded WZZT, not equivalence to the unrestricted model
solver.first_planned_scope: first4 accepted extensions per condition, with explicit prefix truncation; no full-family claim
solver.data_bound_transfer: A data-derived bound from N0 does not automatically apply to a new P/Q control dataset. Recheck the domain for every condition before calling it an unrestricted-model comparison.
solver.rank_deficient_control: If a control has unbounded indistinguishable parameter directions, retain that status. A common predeclared finite box permits only a bounded-algorithm comparison; it is not a proof that the box covers the original unbounded model.
solver.max_atoms_interpretation: 17 frozen initial supports plus4 accepted extensions; diagnostic prefix only
solver.boundary_policy: Keep boundary-limited or unproved attempts unresolved, without tuning bounds from outcome
solver.attribution_boundary: Comparisons within C0/C1/C2 hold output model and domain fixed. Difference from original AC N0 cannot be attributed solely to input variation.

evaluation: all3 conditions and all failed/timeout/bound-limited attempts retained
first4 support choices and whether root clades enter, using truth only after choice
training loss, validation loss, candidate coefficient bounds and actual active constraints
effective family recovery only on a completed final path; never infer it from a successful prefix
nodewise means/std/clipping fractions, P/Q correlation and spatial correlation as descriptive checks only
future_AC_check: Only after the same algorithm/settings have been frozen, replay the same generated P/Q trajectories through the unchanged AC and meter models for all3 conditions. This is a separate paired domain check, not pooled with the noiseless linear control.
exclusions: no reduced measurement noise selected to improve outcomes

interpretation_boundaries.common_profile: If P_t=a_t*p0, Q_t=a_t*q0, p0>0 and v=R*p0+X*q0>=0, the unrestricted nonnegative leaf-only model diag(v_i/p0_i), X=0 fits exactly. Greater common amplitude alone does not distinguish roots.
interpretation_boundaries.proportional_pq: For Q=kappa*P with kappa>0, R/X are confounded but K=R+kappa*X retains nonnegative common block supports. With informative P, topology need not be unidentifiable. Independent Q is not assumed to improve topology.
